papers.title_en: Approximating optimal decoding of quantum LDPC codes with narrow frontiers
papers.evidence: 提出用于量子LDPC码的前沿解码器
papers.tldr: 量子LDPC码的最优解码复杂度高，实际应用需要高效近似方法。本文提出Frontier解码器，通过剪枝动态规划，在排序错误变量后保留窄前沿近似后验质量，避免指数复杂度。在码容量设置下，表面码和彩色码的阈值接近最优；在电路级噪声下，对于[[144,12,12]]码，物理错误率0.001时平均列表大小不足100，达到当前最优性能。该解码器在线性复杂度下实现了近似最优，为低延迟量子解码提供了可能。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Frontier decoder, a pruned dynamic-programming decoder for sparse quantum decoding problems. Frontier processes error variables in a chosen order, merges prefixes with the same residual syndrome and logical label, and approximates logical-coset posterior masses by retaining only a narrow scored frontier. Without pruning, the recursion is exact ordered inference with exponential complexity.   In the code-capacity setting, the decoder reaches thresholds close to optimal for the surface code and the color code. In the circuit-level noise model, it achieves state-of-the-art performance with a very small average retained list size: less than 100 for the gross code $[[144,12,12]]$ at a physical error rate of $0.001$. When the list size is constant, the decoder has linear complexity, suggesting the possibility of low-latency implementations.

papers.title_en: Vine Codes: Low-Overhead Quantum LDPC Codes on a Planar Square Grid
papers.authors: Georgia M. Nixon, Campbell K. McLauchlan, Charles C. L. van Rest
papers.evidence: 提出Vine Codes，一种在平面方网格上的低开销qLDPC码
papers.tldr: 表面码量子比特开销大，而现有qLDPC码需要长程连接，难以在超导平台上实现。为此，本文提出Vine Codes，在平面方形网格上仅用最近邻两量子比特门和路由量子比特实现开放边界qLDPC码。通过数值搜索得到如[[121,4,6]]等候选码，在电路距离7时数据与测量量子比特减少约28%，总量子比特在距离10时减少约18%。电路级噪声模拟表明在10^{-3}噪声率下性能优于表面码。此外，还引入具有单比特 transversal Clifford门的Flip-Vine Codes，并构建了超越表面码的广义开放边界。
papers.abstract_en: The surface code is a promising route towards large-scale quantum computing, requiring only nearest-neighbour gates amenable to superconducting hardware. However, surface codes incur large qubit overheads. Novel quantum low-density parity check (qLDPC) codes promise to reduce overheads but require long-range connections that are difficult to achieve on superconducting platforms. Here, we introduce "Vine Codes" - qLDPC codes that are implementable on a planar square grid through nearest-neighbour, two-qubit gates native to superconducting platforms (iSWAP and CZ). Our approach generalises "Directional Codes" recently introduced by Gehér et. al. (2025) which are constrained to a torus. In contrast, vine codes have open boundary conditions constructed with the aid of routing qubits. We perform extensive numeric searches and find promising candidate vine codes, e.g. [[121,4,6]], [[221,6,7]], and [[234,9,6]] codes. We verify the circuit distances and show that data and measure qubits required can be reduced by up to ~28% relative to the surface code at a circuit distance of 7. Even including routing qubits, vine codes require fewer total qubits than the surface code (e.g. ~18% reduction at circuit distance 10) and benefits are expected to increase at higher distances. We perform circuit-level noise simulations to demonstrate that under a realistic noise model and at a near-term noise rate of $10^{-3}$, vine codes can perform better than the surface code while using fewer qubits. We give an exhaustive list of all unique vine codes up to stabiliser-weight 9. We additionally introduce "Flip-Vine Codes" which possess single-qubit transversal Clifford gates useful for fault-tolerant logic and magic state cultivation. We furthermore construct examples of generalised open boundaries for vine codes that go beyond the familiar X/Z boundaries of the surface and tile codes.

papers.title_en: Topological Codes Based on Space Groups
papers.authors: Chong-Yuan Xu, Ze-Chuan Liu, Yong Xu
papers.evidence: 提出空间群码，一类基于空间群的新型拓扑CSS码
papers.tldr: 传统拓扑码通常假设平移不变性，限制了设计多样性。本文提出空间群码，通过结合点群运算与平移构造CSS码，并使用环模不变量理论分析拓扑性质。发现空间群码比纯平移码具有更好的局域性。该工作拓展了拓扑码的设计空间，有利于与量子计算平台协同设计。
papers.abstract_en: Topological codes form one of the most important classes of stabilizer codes. Most existing algebraic constructions and analyses of topological codes assume translation invariance. Here we show that topological codes can arise in more general settings by incorporating point group operations. The central construction is a class of Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes called space-group codes, whose check operators are built from group-algebra templates over space groups that combine translations with point-group operations. We develop methods for analyzing topological properties of space-group codes using ring-modules and their invariant theory. At first glance, space-group codes might appear to complicate practical implementation; however, we find that they can exhibit greater locality than previous codes based purely on translations. Our framework thus extends the landscape of topological codes and opens up a broader design space for the co-design of topological codes with quantum computing platforms.

papers.title_en: Random Local Stabilizer Codes in Three Dimensions without String or Self-Similar Fractal Logical Operators
papers.evidence: 三维随机局部稳定子码，一类无弦或分形逻辑算符的拓扑码
papers.tldr: 量子纠错码的自纠正能力受弦逻辑算符限制，而Haah的fracton码虽无弦却存在自相似分形逻辑算符导致对数能垒。本文提出一类三维qutrit随机立方码，其稳定子空间变化但保持立方体校验结构。理论证明该码无弦逻辑算符，数值模拟显示基态简并指数与平移不变fracton码不同，且不存在自相似分形逻辑算符。结果表明约束随机性可改变稳定子码的拓扑性质，提升自纠正能力，为设计新量子纠错码和探索新奇量子相提供方向。
papers.abstract_en: Quantum error-correcting codes (QECs) are essential components quantum computation and have deep connections to quantum phases of matter. A key obstruction to passive self-correcting QECs is the presence of string logical operators, which can generate logical errors through constant-energy-barrier processes. Haah's Codes (fracton codes) showed that three-dimensional stabilizer codes can forbid such string logical operators, but their translation-invariant structure supports self-similar fractal logical operators with a logarithmic energy barrier. We introduce the qutrit random cubic codes, a family of local qutrit Calderbank-Shor-Steane stabilizer Hamiltonians with similar cube-check structure as Haah's Code 1 but built from spatially varying stabilizers. We prove that these models retain the no-string property and numerically observe that they have properties distinct from translation-invariant fracton codes: the smallest ground-state degeneracy exponent is $k=2$ for odd $L$ and $k=4$ for even $L$; noncontractible plane-logical operators span the entire logical space; and charge-push diagnostics show that the self-similar fractal operators are absent. These results demonstrate that constrained randomness can fundamentally change the nature of stabilizer codes and improve their self-correction properties. They further point to broader families of quantum error-correcting codes and quantum phases beyond canonical topological and fracton orders.
